business_summary: DB Securities Co., Ltd. engages in investment trading, brokerage, and advisory businesses in South Korea. It is also involved in trust, collective investment, foreign exchange, insurance agencies, payment guarantee, credit granting, loan brokerage. In addition, the company provides foreign exchange business; an insurance agency business; standing agent duties; electronic funds transfer services; credit extension business; trusteeship duties for asset management and securitization companies; buying and selling of negotiable certificates of deposit denominated in Korean Won, and brokerage, arrangement, or agency services thereof; sale of loan receivables and other receivables, and brokerage, arrangement, or agency services thereof; securities lending and borrowing transactions and brokerage, arrangement, or agency services; trust business for corporate bond issuance; loan brokerage, arrangement, or agency services; payment guarantee business; management of third-party security rights over securities held in investor accounts; agency for the affairs of the state or public entities; fund transfer business for investors using investment deposits; credit card recruitment agency business; asset custody services. The company was formerly known as DB Financial Investment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to DB Securities Co., Ltd. in April 2025. DB Securities Co., Ltd. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
